name: Arleigh Burke class (Flight IIA)
note: DDG-51 Flight IIA Aegis guided-missile destroyer with the SPY-1D(V) phased-array radar and 96 Mk-41 VLS cells (32 forward + 64 aft) firing SM-2/SM-6, ESSM, VLA and Tomahawk. name: Type 052D (Luyang III)
note: PLAN Luyang III guided-missile destroyer, China's most numerous modern DDG ('Chinese Aegis'). Type 346A four-panel AESA radar and 64 universal VLS cells (32 fwd + 32 aft) firing HHQ-9 SAM, YJ-18 anti-ship and CJ-10 land-attack missiles. Carries a Harbin Z-9 helicopter (Z-20 on the stretched 052DL). Displacement and crew are not in the retrieved excerpt.

name: Kolkata class
note: Indian Navy Kolkata class (Project 15A), India's first stealth destroyers. EL/M-2248 MF-STAR AESA plus Thales LW-08 radar. Air defence uses four 8-cell VLS (32 Barak-8/MRSAM cells); the primary offensive load is 16 BrahMos in a Universal Vertical Launcher Module. Enclosed hangar for two helicopters. Crew is not in the retrieved excerpt.

Helicopter landing deck but no embarked hangar; speed and crew are not in the retrieved excerpt.
